title: Object Storage: negotiated rate allowed
content:
Object Storage negotiated rate allowed is defined as follows: Whether an approved signed unit-rate amendment overrides the standard primary rate; boolean.

| Contract tier | Negotiated rate allowed |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | negotiated rate allowed: permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | negotiated rate allowed: permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | negotiated rate allowed: permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | negotiated rate allowed: permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | negotiated rate allowed: permitted |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | negotiated rate allowed: permitted |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the negotiated rate allowed entry is permitted.
